name: sgs/site-footer
title: SGS Site Footer
description: The site footer shell — stacked optional rows (top / columns / bottom bar) of footer elements. Each row is an intrinsic never-overflow cluster or column grid, so the footer never overflows the viewport at any width. Lives inside the footer template part.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: backgroundOverlayColour/Opacity/OpacityTablet/OpacityMobile/ColourHover/BlendMode are the shared whole-block BACKGROUND PANEL (rendered by class-sgs-container-wrapper.php's sgs_overlay_decls()), not media elements -- same settled reasoning as sgs/container (see its block.json for the full note, 2026-09-03, Bean-directed). Detector rule 37-media-no-handroll's bare `background`/`bg`-prefix discriminator excludes this whole family from supports.sgs.mediaElements by design.

wrapper.label: Section wrapper
wrapper._note: The rendered <footer>/<div> element (containerKind=section, rendered through SGS_Container_Wrapper per the composite-mirror rule R-31-9). Colour is now SGS-OWNED (backgroundColour/textColour + Gradient/Hover siblings, D294/D684 pattern — mirrors sgs/site-header's already-migrated shape) rather than riding native WP supports; spacing/border still ride the native supports, all serialised SCOPED via __experimentalSkipSerialization (Spec 32). The typography members are honest GAPs: this block declares no `supports.typography` and no font-* attributes. anim:preset/easing/stagger/trigger are honest GAPs too (no sgsAnimation*/stagger attributes); bgKenBurns is a Ken-Burns preset toggle with no animation-cluster member, so it stays unmapped exactly as on sgs/container.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Arrangement members map explicitly because this element declares no `prefix`. css:grid-template-columns maps to the `columns` COUNT attribute (SGS_Container_Wrapper expands it to repeat(N,1fr)) — this block has no explicit gridTemplateColumns ratio attribute, unlike sgs/container. css:align-items maps to `alignItems` (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:247 reads alignItems||alignItems). `alignContent` was REMOVED (2026-09-03, Bean-directed): the shared wrapper only ever emits align-content in its GRID branch (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php ~1297) and this block's `layout` is fixed to 'flex' with no picker to reach grid, so the attribute could never produce CSS — genuinely dead schema, not a gap. display / justify-items / order / overflow / grid-template-rows / grid-auto-rows have no attribute on this block and remain honest GAPs.

decorative.label: Decorative background
decorative._note: Background image/video (backgroundImage*/bgVideo*), background SVG (bgSvg*), overlay gradient (overlayGradient*/backgroundOverlay*), Ken Burns, and shape dividers (shapeDivider*) are governed by dedicated controls outside the Text/Fill/Layout style clusters, so this element declares none. Mirrors sgs/container's `decorative` element.

layout.description: Fixed to 'flex' — the footer shell is always a vertical flex stack of its rows. No client-facing picker (mirrors sgs/container's layout enum only in that it is the same attribute name the shared wrapper reads via class-sgs-container-wrapper.php's elseif('flex'===$layout) branch); declaring it here is what makes flexDirection/flexWrap (below) actually reach rendered CSS instead of being dead attributes (21-render-without-control).

flexDirection.description: Default 'column' (not the CSS-initial 'row'/''): this block's THREE rows (top/columns/bottom) must keep stacking vertically once `layout` starts resolving to 'flex' and the shared wrapper actually emits display:flex on the content band. A '' default here would flip the rows to sit side-by-side by row-axis default — a visual regression this attribute's own addition would otherwise cause. flexWrap's column-axis invariant (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php) then coerces wrap->nowrap for this direction, matching the pre-existing block-flow stacking exactly.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
